simple.meaning: אֲסֵפָה (ʼăçêphâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a collection of people (only adverbial).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֲסֵפָה (H626) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אֲסֵפָה (H626) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אֲסֵפָה (ʼăçêphâh) / H626 is traced through Isaiah 24:22 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H626. asephah אֲסֵפָה noun feminine verbal. a collecting, gathering ; א ׳אֻסְּפוּ אַסִּיר Isa 24:22 they are collected, as a collecting captives unto a pit (dungeon); or they are gathered with a gathering (as) captives , compare 22:18 ; but perhaps read הָאַסִּיר אֹסֶף (construct); see Weir Che.
